raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "get tichete de masă"
  role subject "everyone from the Iași office"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be from"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the Iași office"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "get tichete de masă"
      role subject ?x
      polarity negated
    end
  end
